name: Task Runner
description: A2A reference agent exercising the full task lifecycle: SendMessage, SSE streaming, GetTask/ListTasks/CancelTask, SubscribeToTask, and push notifications. Serves A2A 1.0 and, on the same URL, A2A 0.3. Echoes input over N work units (default 5).

skills.name: Echo over time
skills.description: Accept any text input and emit N artifact updates spaced 50ms apart, then complete the task.
